initialExam.title: Supreme Court Junior Court Assistant 2026
initialExam.description: Supreme Court recruits Junior Court Assistants for clerical and administrative work in the apex court.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree with 60% marks, typing speed 35 wpm English / 30 wpm Hindi
initialExam.syllabus: Part I: English, GK, Aptitude. Part II: Typing/Computer test.
initialExam.examPattern: Written (100 marks, 2 hours) → Typing Test → Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Skill Test (Typing) → Interview → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Court Assistant in Supreme Court of India
initialExam.careerGrowth: JCA → Senior Court Assistant → Branch Officer → Registrar.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit sci.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Delhi allowance, Pension
